validation_results.lifecycle_derivation: State names PREPARED / EFFECT_ATTEMPT_STARTED / RECEIPT_CAPTURED / DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN / DISPATCH_NOT_STARTED are the .1R.16 §22.3 vocabulary (RPAC-001 defines no alternate names for this non-authoritative mirror). Transitions: none->PREPARED; PREPARED->EFFECT_ATTEMPT_STARTED; PREPARED->DISPATCH_NOT_STARTED; EFFECT_ATTEMPT_STARTED->RECEIPT_CAPTURED; EFFECT_ATTEMPT_STARTED->DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN -- exactly 5 ALLOW edges; RECEIPT_CAPTURED / DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN / DISPATCH_NOT_STARTED terminal. resolve_disposition maps durable latest state to the RDGO-001 v3.1 §17 crash vocabulary (DISPATCH_NOT_STARTED_AFTER_ATTEMPT_MARKER for PREPARED; DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN for an unresolved EFFECT_ATTEMPT_STARTED). automatic_retry_permitted is False for every state once a record exists (RDGO-001 v3.1 §18).
validation_results.semantic_wall: RuntimeInvocationRecord != permission != human approval != PB ALLOW != runtime capability != authorization to dispatch. Structural: no approve / authorize / permit / grant / consume method; no execution_allowed / permission / authorized field; GRANTS_NO_EFFECT_AUTHORITY permanent; record_grants_no_effect_authority() always True; a copied / reconstructed / dict-round-tripped record grants nothing. The authoritative at-most-once authority-consumption truth stays consumption.json (HPAC-AUTHORITY-CONSUMPTION/2.1), which every consumer re-reads (RDGO-001 v3.1 §11).
validation_results.write_before_effect: Model A + Model C (.1R.16 §22.2): the durable EFFECT_ATTEMPT_STARTED transition is written before any future external effect boundary (which is Slice C and absent here). Model A's failure mode (a false 'attempted' after a crash) is fail-closed (DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN + fresh human authority); Model B's (a duplicate external effect) is fail-open and rejected. No effect primitive added; the mirror module contains no adapter.dispatch() call site.
validation_results.at_most_once_guarantee: at-most-once dispatch ATTEMPT with fail-closed uncertainty -- not generic exactly-once external effect (RDGO-001 v3.1 §17). Once EFFECT_ATTEMPT_STARTED is durable: a second begin_effect_attempt raises DispatchAttemptAlreadyStartedError; a restart (fresh store object, durable state only) observes the marker and refuses; an unresolved started attempt resolves to DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN. Concurrent contenders: O_CREAT|O_EXCL + os.link -> exactly one winner (8-thread test: 1 won / 7 lost).

validation_results.idempotency_key_derivation: derive_dispatch_attempt_record_id(invocation_id, attempt_id) = 'dar-' + sha256_canonical({invocation_id, attempt_id})[:32]. The RPAC-REQ-065 idempotency_key is carried on the record binding from the DispatchEnvelope and never by itself authorizes redispatch.
